items.name: ui_scroll_position
items.docs: The initial scroll position for the thread view, set during session registration.

items.name: TOOL_NAME_META_KEY
items.docs:
Key used in ACP ToolCall meta to store the tool's programmatic name.
This is a workaround since ACP's ToolCall doesn't have a dedicated name field.

items.name: buffer
items.docs: Returns the buffer being edited (for pending diffs) or the snapshot buffer (for finalized diffs).

items.name: set_provisional_title
items.docs:
Sets a provisional display title without propagating back to the
underlying agent connection. This is used for quick preview titles
(e.g. first 20 chars of the user message) that should be shown
immediately but replaced once the LLM generates a proper title via
`set_title`.

items.name: supports_load_session
items.docs: Whether this agent supports loading existing sessions.

items.name: config_options
items.docs: Get all current config options with their state

items.name: SUBAGENT_SESSION_INFO_META_KEY
items.docs: Key used in ACP ToolCall meta to store the session id and message indexes

items.name: watch
items.docs:
Whenever the model list is updated the receiver will be notified.
Optional for agents that don't update their model list.

items.name: InProgress
items.docs: The tool call is currently running.

items.name: supports_close_session
items.docs: Whether this agent supports closing existing sessions.

items.name: flush_streaming_text
items.docs: Flush all buffered streaming text into the Markdown entity immediately.

items.name: bytes_to_reveal_per_tick
items.docs: The number of bytes to reveal per timer turn.

items.name: message_end_index
items.docs: The index of the output of the message that the subagent has returned

items.name: build_outcome_for_checked_patterns
items.docs:
Build a `SelectedPermissionOutcome` for the `DropdownWithPatterns`
variant when the user has checked specific pattern indices.

Returns `Some` with the always-allow/deny outcome when at least one
pattern is checked. Returns `None` when zero patterns are checked,
signaling that the caller should degrade to allow-once / deny-once.

Panics (debug) or returns `None` (release) if called on a non-
`DropdownWithPatterns` variant.

items.name: MaxOutputTokensError
items.docs: Returned when the model stops because it exhausted its output token budget.

items.name: upsert_tool_call_inner
items.docs: Fails if id does not match an existing entry.

items.name: Rejected
items.docs: The user rejected the tool call.

items.name: resume_session
items.docs: Resume an existing session by ID without replaying previous messages.

items.name: TASK_UPDATE_MS
items.docs:
The number of milliseconds between each timer tick, controlling how quickly
text is revealed.

items.name: AgentModelSelector
items.docs:
Trait for agents that support listing, selecting, and querying language models.

This is an optional capability; agents indicate support via [AgentConnection::model_selector].

items.name: Pending
items.docs:
The tool call hasn't started running yet, but we start showing it to
the user.

items.name: tool_name_from_meta
items.docs: Helper to extract tool name from ACP meta

items.name: Path
items.docs: Path to a custom SVG icon file.

items.name: restore_checkpoint
items.docs: Restores the git working tree to the state at the given checkpoint (if one exists)

items.name: selected_model
items.docs:
Retrieves the currently selected model for a specific session (thread).

# Parameters
- `cx`: The GPUI app context.

# Returns
A task resolving to the selected model (always set) or an error (e.g., session not found).

items.name: load_session
items.docs: Load an existing session by ID.

items.name: PermissionPattern
items.docs:
Pairs a tool's permission pattern with its display name

For example, a pattern of `^cargo\\s+build(\\s|$)` would display as `cargo
build`. It's handy to keep these together rather than trying to derive
one from the other.

items.name: session_id
items.docs: The session id of the subagent sessiont that was spawned

items.name: thread_data
items.docs:
A representation of the current thread state that can be serialized for
storage with telemetry events.

items.name: stop_by_user
items.docs:
Marks this terminal as stopped by user action and then kills it.
This should be called when the user explicitly clicks a Stop button.

items.name: should_render_footer
items.docs: Returns whether the model picker should render a footer.

items.name: Completed
items.docs: The tool call completed successfully.

items.name: close_session
items.docs: Close an existing session. Allows the agent to free the session from memory.

items.name: start_streaming_reveal
items.docs:
Spawns a foreground task that periodically drains
`streaming_text_buffer.pending` into the target `Markdown` entity,
producing smooth, continuous text output.

items.name: target
items.docs: The Markdown entity being streamed into.

items.name: draft_prompt
items.docs: The user's unsent prompt text, persisted so it can be restored when reloading the thread.

items.name: Named
items.docs: A built-in icon from Zed's icon set.

items.name: Canceled
items.docs: The user canceled generation so the tool call was canceled.

items.name: base_text
items.docs: Returns the original text before any edits were applied.

items.name: supports_session_history
items.docs: Whether this agent supports showing session history.

items.name: REVEAL_TARGET
items.docs: The time in milliseconds to reveal the entire pending text.

items.name: select_model
items.docs:
Selects a model for a specific session (thread).

This sets the default model for future interactions in the session.
If the session doesn't exist or the model is invalid, it returns an error.

# Parameters
- `model`: The model to select (should be one from [list_models]).
- `cx`: The GPUI app context.

# Returns
A task resolving to `Ok(())` on success or an error.

items.name: streaming_text_buffer
items.docs:
Buffer for smooth text streaming. Holds text that has been received from
the model but not yet revealed in the UI. A timer task drains this buffer
gradually to create a fluid typing effect instead of choppy chunk-at-a-time
updates.

items.name: meta_with_tool_name
items.docs: Helper to create meta with tool name

items.name: AgentModelIcon
items.docs: Icon for a model in the model selector.

items.name: rewind
items.docs:
Rewinds this thread to before the entry at `index`, removing it and all
subsequent entries while rejecting any action_log changes made from that point.
Unlike `restore_checkpoint`, this method does not restore from git.

items.name: WaitingForConfirmation
items.docs: The tool call is waiting for confirmation from the user.

items.name: buffer_streaming_text
items.docs:
Add text to the streaming buffer. If the target changed (e.g. switching
from thoughts to message text), flush the old buffer first.

items.name: pending
items.docs: Text received from the model but not yet appended to the Markdown source.

items.name: build_outcome
items.docs:
Build a `SelectedPermissionOutcome` for this choice.

If the choice carries `sub_patterns`, they are attached as
`SelectedPermissionParams::Terminal`.

items.name: set_config_option
items.docs:
Set a config option value
Returns the full updated list of config options

items.name: message_start_index
items.docs: The index of the message of the start of the "turn" run by this tool call

items.name: was_stopped_by_user
items.docs: Returns whether this terminal was stopped by explicit user action.

items.name: upsert_tool_call
items.docs: Updates a tool call if id matches an existing entry, otherwise inserts a new one.

items.name: Failed
items.docs: The tool call failed.

items.name: user_stopped
items.docs:
Flag indicating whether this terminal was stopped by explicit user action
(e.g., clicking the Stop button). This is set before kill() is called
so that code awaiting wait_for_exit() can check it deterministically.

items.name: supports_resume_session
items.docs: Whether this agent supports resuming existing sessions without loading history.

items.name: _reveal_task
items.docs: Timer task that periodically moves text from `pending` into `source`.

items.name: watch
items.docs:
Whenever the config options are updated the receiver will be notified.
Optional for agents that don't update their config options dynamically.

items.name: model_selector
items.docs:
Returns this agent as an [Rc<dyn ModelSelector>] if the model selection capability is supported.

If the agent does not support model selection, returns [None].
This allows sharing the selector in UI components.

items.name: list_models
items.docs:
Lists all available language models for this agent.

# Parameters
- `cx`: The GPUI app context for async operations and global access.

# Returns
A task resolving to the list of models or an error (e.g., if no models are configured).

items.name: subagent_session_info_from_meta
items.docs: Helper to extract subagent session id from ACP meta
